h1: AI Instagram Ads You Can Make in Minutes
lead: Why wait on a creator or a shoot? Make a clear Instagram ad in minutes, then spin up another version before the offer ends.
card: Instagram ads from one product photo, as a tall clip or a square photo.

faq.q: What counts as an Instagram ad I can run?
faq.a: A Reel, a Story, or a feed post that shows your product: someone holding it, an unboxing, or a short review. It sits beside everyday posts, and that is why people trust it.

faq.q: How do I get an Instagram Reel from my product link?
faq.a: Paste the product link. You get a script, captions, and a Reel shaped for the feed, Reels, or Stories. Then pick the AI actor and the voice.

faq.q: Are there ready Reel templates I can use?
faq.a: Yes. Open a Reel, Story, or feed template and keep your product in the frame. The shape is already set.

faq.q: What does an Instagram Reel cost in credits?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Do I get music, captions, and a voice on the Reel?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a spoken voice, captions, and a track from the music library. The same line can be spoken in another language. You can still change a word before you export.

faq.q: Can I run the Reel as a paid Instagram ad?
faq.a: Yes. Publish it or download it and run it in Instagram ads. The download has no watermark. Instagram still applies its own ad rules.

faq.q: Do I have to book a person and a room?
faq.a: No. Use a photo you already have, or paste a product link. The person in the Reel is an AI actor from a library of 53. You can have the file in minutes.

faq.q: What should I check before I download the Reel?
faq.a: Compare your placement with [social media ad sizes](/guides/ad-sizes-by-platform), then preview the file so on-screen buttons do not cover the product.
